$description: Semantic colour with light and dark modes, fill themes, contextual fill and chart colours.

com.desertpants.source: Visual language derived from desertant.com (brand/index.css, assets/site.css, captured 2026-09-23/24). Logos, marks, product names, photography and copy are not included.

bg.$description: Grounds. Light value is $value; dark value is in $extensions.com.desertpants.modes.dark.

surface.$description: Inputs, code blocks, selected tab, chips, result boxes.

card.$description: List cards and use-case blocks. Dark value is a desert-pants addition (the source keeps cream-dark in every mode).

tint.$description: Tinted wells: tags, tabs container, prompt cards, progress tracks, hover grounds.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder feature card ground (same in both modes: it stands in for artwork, whose colours are fixed).

theme.fixed: stands in for artwork, whose colours no theme changes

accent.$description: Accent fill: primary buttons, selected segments and chips.

text.$description: Text and icon colours. Each note names the grounds it is checked on.

primary.$description: Primary text and icons on every ground in color.bg.

secondary.$description: Secondary text (menu items, blockquotes, notes) on every ground in color.bg.

muted.$description: Muted text: labels, eyebrows, metadata, inactive tabs, on canvas, surface, raised, sunken and card.

muted-strong.$description: Muted text at 11-12px (notes, hints, code labels, language glosses) on every ground.

faint.$description: Disabled labels and decorative separators only (breadcrumb slashes). Never informational text.

contrast.known-failure: Source value: 2.51:1 light, 3.75:1 dark. Allowed only for disabled controls and decoration (WCAG 1.4.3 exemption).

accent.$description: Links and accent text on every ground in color.bg.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on color.bg.accent (primary buttons, selected segments).

subtle.$description: Hairlines, card and code borders, table rules, dividers. Decorative (not a control boundary).

default.$description: Outline tags, blockquote rules and other decorative outlines that are not a control boundary.

control.$description: Boundary of a control that has no label inside it (text inputs, search fields, selects): 3:1 on every ground (WCAG 1.4.11). The source draws inputs with the 20% default border; desert-pants raises it.

strong.$description: Outline buttons, stat frames, selected tag ring; any border that marks a control boundary.

ring.$description: Focus ring (2px solid, 2-4px offset) on every interactive element.

hover.$description: Hover ground for quiet controls (nav items, menu items, outline buttons).

selected.$description: Selected ground (current side-nav item: text-primary at 10%).

pressed.$description: Pressed ground for touch (no hover on touch screens).

disabled-fg.$description: Disabled control label (exempt from contrast minimums).

signal.$description: Status signals. Colour is never the only carrier: every signal pairs with a word or an icon.

fill.$description: Success dots, icons, bars and error borders (non-text marks, 3:1 on canvas in both modes; the same in both modes).

text.$description: Success text on every ground in color.bg and on color.signal.success.soft.

soft.$description: Success tint behind entity highlights and inline alerts (fill at 16%, composited over the ground in either mode).

fill.$description: Warning dots, icons, bars and error borders (non-text marks, 3:1 on canvas in both modes; the same in both modes).

text.$description: Warning text on every ground in color.bg and on color.signal.warning.soft.

soft.$description: Warning tint behind entity highlights and inline alerts (fill at 16%, composited over the ground in either mode).

fill.$description: Danger dots, icons, bars and error borders (non-text marks, 3:1 on canvas in both modes; the same in both modes).

text.$description: Danger text on every ground in color.bg and on color.signal.danger.soft.

on-fill.$description: Text and icons on color.signal.danger.fill (danger badges, destructive swipe actions); the same in both modes, as the fill is.

soft.$description: Danger tint behind entity highlights and inline alerts (fill at 16%, composited over the ground in either mode).

fill.$description: Info dots, icons, bars and error borders (non-text marks, 3:1 on canvas in both modes; the same in both modes).

text.$description: Info text on every ground in color.bg and on color.signal.info.soft.

soft.$description: Info tint behind entity highlights and inline alerts (fill at 16%, composited over the ground in either mode).

scrim.$description: Scrim behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

photo-strong.$description: Photo scrim start (bottom edge) behind text on photos.

theme.fixed: sits on photographs, whose colours no theme changes
sits on photographs, whose colours no theme changes

surface-dark.$description: Dark surface context (a forest block inside a light page). Values do not change with mode.

tag-bg.$description: Tag ground on a dark block (#fbfaf414).

button-bg.$description: Primary button fill on a dark block.

button-hover.$description: Primary button hover on a dark block.

button-text.$description: Primary button label on a dark block.

outline-hover.$description: Outline button hover ground on a dark block.

fill.$description: Fill themes: whole-surface colour blocks (feature cards, panels, fill heroes, card hovers, side-nav current items). Each theme carries its own inks. Values are identical in light and dark mode.

context.$description: Contextual fill: re-pointed to one fill theme by a scope (web: class .dp-fill-<name>; iOS: DP.fills[name]; Android: DesertPants.fills[name], each a DPFill / DpFill with the same roles). Defaults to sage, as the source's :root theme does.

bg.$description: Context bg: the bg of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

ink.$description: Context ink: the ink of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

sub.$description: Context sub: the sub of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

line.$description: Context line: the line of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

cta-ink.$description: Context cta-ink: the cta-ink of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

muted.$description: Context muted: the muted of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

panel.$description: Context panel: the panel of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

com.desertpants.source: desertant.com brand/index.css .panel color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme) 90%, transparent)

ink-5.$description: Context ink-5: the ink-5 of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

com.desertpants.source: desertant.com brand/index.css .panel .table--lined color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 5%, transparent)

ink-8.$description: Context ink-8: the ink-8 of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

com.desertpants.source: desertant.com brand/index.css .hero-model .btn--outline:hover color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 8%, transparent)

ink-10.$description: Context ink-10: the ink-10 of the fill theme in scope (default sage).

chart.$description: Data visualisation. Marks carry a 2px outline in the context ink, so series colour is never the only distinction.

mark.$description: Outline of every bar, column and dot; fill of the highlighted series.

series-1.$description: Series 1 fill for multi-series charts (always outlined with color.chart.mark; lines are cased in it).

series-2.$description: Series 2 fill for multi-series charts (always outlined with color.chart.mark; lines are cased in it).

series-3.$description: Series 3 fill for multi-series charts (always outlined with color.chart.mark; lines are cased in it).

series-4.$description: Series 4 fill for multi-series charts (always outlined with color.chart.mark; lines are cased in it).

series-5.$description: Series 5 fill for multi-series charts (always outlined with color.chart.mark; lines are cased in it).

series-6.$description: Series 6 fill for multi-series charts (always outlined with color.chart.mark; lines are cased in it).

ink.$description: Chart ink on page grounds (canvas, surface, raised, sunken, inset, card): outlines of bars, columns and dots, the casing of series lines, strong labels. Charts inside a fill use color.chart.mark, the fill's ink.

tick.$description: Tick, axis and legend labels on page grounds (inside a fill: color.chart.label).

focus.$description: The one emphasis per chart: the series, bar, point, line or cell the eye should land on, filled in the chart ink (inside a fill: color.chart.mark). Never a category and at most one per chart; everything else is muted. Non-text mark: 3:1 on every ground.

context.$description: Context series, lines and points drawn behind the focus (peers, benchmarks, prior periods).

axis.$description: Axis and zero baseline (3:1: the baseline is what bar lengths are read from).

grid.$description: Gridlines: sparse and quiet (decorative; values are labelled).

band.$description: Confidence bands, target ranges, regime and forecast shading.

up.$description: Rises and gains (up bars, candle bodies, positive steps); pair with a sign or a glyph.

down.$description: Falls and losses (down bars, candle bodies, negative steps); pair with a sign or a glyph.

tooltip-bg.$description: Tooltip ground (the inverse pair, legible in both modes).

seq-1.$description: Sequential ramp step 1 of 5 (one measure, low to high: heatmaps, calendars, density): 15% from the canvas toward the theme's blue in OKLab.

seq-1-label.$description: Text on color.chart.seq-1 (whichever of text.primary and text.inverse contrasts more).

seq-2.$description: Sequential ramp step 2 of 5 (one measure, low to high: heatmaps, calendars, density): 35% from the canvas toward the theme's blue in OKLab.

seq-2-label.$description: Text on color.chart.seq-2 (whichever of text.primary and text.inverse contrasts more).

seq-3.$description: Sequential ramp step 3 of 5 (one measure, low to high: heatmaps, calendars, density): 55% from the canvas toward the theme's blue in OKLab.

seq-3-label.$description: Text on color.chart.seq-3 (whichever of text.primary and text.inverse contrasts more).

seq-4.$description: Sequential ramp step 4 of 5 (one measure, low to high: heatmaps, calendars, density): 80% from the canvas toward the theme's blue in OKLab.

seq-4-label.$description: Text on color.chart.seq-4 (whichever of text.primary and text.inverse contrasts more).

seq-5.$description: Sequential ramp step 5 of 5 (one measure, low to high: heatmaps, calendars, density): 100% from the canvas toward the theme's blue in OKLab.

seq-5-label.$description: Text on color.chart.seq-5 (whichever of text.primary and text.inverse contrasts more).

div-1.$description: Diverging ramp step 1 of 5, strong negative (signed values around a midpoint: variance, correlation): 100% from the canvas toward the theme's red in OKLab.

div-2.$description: Diverging ramp step 2 of 5, negative (signed values around a midpoint: variance, correlation): 50% from the canvas toward the theme's red in OKLab.

div-3.$description: Diverging ramp step 3 of 5, neutral midpoint (signed values around a midpoint: variance, correlation): the sunken ground (distinct from the canvas, so a zero cell stays visible).

div-4.$description: Diverging ramp step 4 of 5, positive (signed values around a midpoint: variance, correlation): 50% from the canvas toward the theme's blue in OKLab.

div-5.$description: Diverging ramp step 5 of 5, strong positive (signed values around a midpoint: variance, correlation): 100% from the canvas toward the theme's blue in OKLab.

progress-alt.$description: Secondary bar fill (non-leading result). Decorative: pair with a text value.

syntax.$description: Syntax highlighting for code blocks (light: VS Code Light+ as the source renders it; dark: Dark+). Every colour meets 4.5:1 on color.bg.surface.

number.$description: Numbers and constants (Light+ #098658 darkened to reach 4.5:1 on the surface).

theme.$description: Browser and OS chrome colour: <meta name="theme-color"> for each colour scheme, the web app manifest theme_color and background_color, the Android status and navigation bars and the iOS launch screen. Follows the canvas in both modes.

terminal.$description: Terminal colours for TUIs, code consoles and the exported terminal schemes: the sixteen ANSI colours plus ground, text, cursor and selection. Colour 0-15 order. Each theme supplies its own; contrast is checked against the terminal ground.

black.$description: ANSI colour 0: black. Text colour in light terminals (4.5:1); a ground in dark ones.

red.$description: ANSI colour 1: red. Text in this colour (4.5:1 on the ground).

green.$description: ANSI colour 2: green. Text in this colour (4.5:1 on the ground).

yellow.$description: ANSI colour 3: yellow. Text in this colour (4.5:1 on the ground).

blue.$description: ANSI colour 4: blue. Text in this colour (4.5:1 on the ground).

magenta.$description: ANSI colour 5: magenta. Text in this colour (4.5:1 on the ground).

cyan.$description: ANSI colour 6: cyan. Text in this colour (4.5:1 on the ground).

white.$description: ANSI colour 7: white. Text colour in dark terminals (4.5:1); a ground in light ones.

bright-black.$description: ANSI colour 8: bright black. Dim text: comments, hints (3:1 on the ground).

bright-red.$description: ANSI colour 9: bright red. Bold and highlight uses (3:1 on the ground).

bright-green.$description: ANSI colour 10: bright green. Bold and highlight uses (3:1 on the ground).

bright-yellow.$description: ANSI colour 11: bright yellow. Bold and highlight uses (3:1 on the ground).

bright-blue.$description: ANSI colour 12: bright blue. Bold and highlight uses (3:1 on the ground).

bright-magenta.$description: ANSI colour 13: bright magenta. Bold and highlight uses (3:1 on the ground).

bright-cyan.$description: ANSI colour 14: bright cyan. Bold and highlight uses (3:1 on the ground).

bright-white.$description: ANSI colour 15: bright white. Emphasis in dark terminals (4.5:1); a ground in light ones.
